children: may retest a resistance at $4,466 per ounce, a break above which could lead to a gain to $4,511.
The bounce from $4,395 seems to have adopted a small wedge pattern. Generally, this is a bearish continuation pattern, to be followed by a resumption of the downtrend.

However, under certain circumstances, it may turn out to be a bottom pattern. A break above $4,466 will confirm the bottom pattern, while a break below $4,428 may signal the continuation of the downtrend.
On the daily chart, the fall from $4,696 looks so deep that it could hardly be classified as a pullback toward the falling trendline.
Instead, the fall might be either a deep correction toward the $4,011-$3,945 range, where the trough of the wave b lies, or a continuation of the downtrend from $5,595.
However, the metal managed to stabilize around a support at $4,417. It is likely to consolidate above this level for a few days before falling.
